entries.status: Hyperframes renderer active; GSAP adapter supported upstream; Storylens captions currently use custom deterministic drawing
entries.guidance: For new motion templates, Qwen 9B Vision observes source frames, Qwen 14B plans words/timing/recipe parameters, deterministic code measures full text layout, GSAP animates properties and Hyperframes captures frames. Register one paused root timeline by composition ID and seek absolute time. GSAP cannot solve bad grouping, font measurement or spacing by itself. Preserve current accepted caption renderer; benchmark an optional template before migration. Smart Visuals can use meaningful entrance, reading hold and exit synchronized to speech. Smart Zoom and cinematic cutting already have native frame/FFmpeg timing; reuse easing/keyframe data rather than adding browser rendering to ordinary crops. Native editor export needs separate tested keyframe mapping; arbitrary GSAP code does not become editable Premiere text automatically.

entries.status: Classic source installed separately for evaluation; no Storylens editor replacement
entries.guidance: OpenCut Classic is the archived, usable editor codebase: study timeline operations, undo/redo commands, snapping, storage, preview and export separation. OpenCut rewrite lists Editor API, plugins, MCP and headless automation as upcoming; do not expose them as working Storylens tools. Storylens is Python plus plain web UI, Classic is a Next/React/Bun app with WASM; selective adaptation is safer than copying its application wholesale. Preserve Storylens saved projects and existing native exports.

messages.text: Advice only; do not run tools or edit videos. From the saved creative repository guidance, explain briefly how GSAP and Hyperframes could work with our Qwen models. Is Taste Skill model training, and are OpenCut rewrite APIs already usable?

GSAP (GreenSock Animation Platform) and Hyperframes can work with Qwen models by leveraging GSAP for smooth animations and Hyperframes for capturing and rendering frames. Qwen models can plan the words, timing, and recipe parameters, while GSAP handles the animation properties and Hyperframes captures the final frames. Taste Skill is a frontend design guidance model, not a training model. OpenCut rewrite APIs are not yet usable as they are part of an upcoming rewrite and not currently implemented in Storylens.
